text:
emma_cs: quick weekly pulse for AcmeCorp onboarding — focused on error-rate breakdown (5xx / timeouts / rate-limit). noticed a 3.2% increase in 5xx from 00:00-06:00 UTC, mostly from streaming and rerank endpoints. posting the top failing endpoints and immediate asks. :eyes:

raj_ops: thanks — can you paste the top URIs and counts? i’ll check infra logs and rate-limit bursts.

emma_cs: sure — short list from our monitoring (last 24h):
```
POST /v1/generate/stream   5xx: 124 errors, timeouts: 18, p95 latency +220ms
POST /v1/chat/reply       5xx: 86 errors, rate_limit: 42, p95 latency +150ms
POST /v1/embeddings       5xx: 21 errors, rate_limit: 9, p99 latency spike during commits
GET  /v1/model/status      5xx: 14 errors (backend timeout)
```

olivia_se: noted. most 5xx on /generate/stream coincide with a model rollout yesterday morning — could be kernel selection mismatch on the dedicated pool.

mike_infra: i’m seeing GPU host restarts around 02:10 UTC for pool-dedicated-2, kernel OOM on one node. restarting the node cleared the backlog but kv-cache warmup caused extra latency.

emma_cs: action items i propose: 1) temporarily route AcmeCorp -> fallback model variant for streaming (lower mem) 2) throttle burst concurrent_streams to 20 for next 2h 3) support to confirm rate-limit headers and whether client retried aggressively. can @tom_support own comms with Acme?

tom_support: yep, i’ll ping the customer and ask them to share request patterns and any retries. will confirm whether they hit client-side retries after 429s.

oncall-bot: incident-notify: pool-dedicated-2 node-7 rebooted at 2026-03-21T02:12:14Z (auto-recover). link: https://monitoring.redwood.example/incident/INC-2247

raj_ops: infra will push a mitigation: cordon node-7, rebuild with updated kernel flags, and enable HA fallback for that pool. estimate ETA 45m. will also add a temporary autoscale rule to absorb bursts.

olivia_se: for model side, i’ll pin Acme to model-1.3-quantized for the next 24h and run a quick synthetic workload to validate latency.

emma_cs: perfect. small follow-ups: add these metrics to the weekly customer report (5xx by endpoint, client-side retries, spend delta) and flag renewal health if errors persist >48h. also note that Acme’s spend increased 12% because of retries.

tom_support: noted. i’ll include a short summary and ETA in the customer message.

mike_infra: mitigation started at 02:35 UTC. reducing concurrent_streams config on the route to 20 now. will update when autoscale rule is live.

emma_cs: thanks team. will re-check in 2h with updated error counts. :thumbsup:
